title: Restore equity calculation performance headroom
description: Follow-up from TASK-7.1: the full-ring equity scenarios run at about 88% of their p95 latency target on the reference Mac, so small regressions will break the target. The global 30 s testTimeout was raised for the slowest equity tests and also loosens every other test.

nodes.title: Bootstrap the strict TypeScript project with one-command checks
Rank showdown hands by real poker hand rankings
Run every check in GitHub Actions on each push and pull request
Compute a hand's equity against opponent hands

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given the full-speed equity command (EQUITY_PERF_SCALE=1) on the reference Mac, When it runs, Then every scenario's p95 is at most 75% of its target
Given vite.config.ts, When tests run, Then the default per-test timeout applies everywhere except the tests that need longer, which set their own timeout
Given postflop advice at a 10-seat flop with 9 opponents, When the advice latency test runs at real targets, Then p95 is at most 75 ms (currently 71.5 ms against 100 ms)

Given a 9-opponent postflop spot, When the user's advice is computed with value betting (two equity runs: whole and calling range), Then p95 latency meets the 100 ms target (TASK-7.8 measured ~205 ms because the calling-range run exhausts the sampler's rejection budget before falling back)
